items.title_en: At least 31 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway
items.title_zh: 開羅高速公路油罐車車禍引發大火，至少 31 人死亡
items.summary_en: A fuel tanker crashed on a highway in Cairo. The accident caused a big fire. Many people died and others were hurt.
items.summary_zh: 一輛油罐車在開羅的高速公路上發生車禍。這場意外引發了大火。許多人不幸喪生，也有多人受傷。
items.why_important_en: This is a major traffic accident that caused many deaths. It highlights road safety issues in the city.
items.why_important_zh: 這是一起造成多人死亡的重大交通事故。它凸顯了該城市的道路安全問題。

vocab.definition_en: A sudden accident where a vehicle hits something.
vocab.sentence_en: I was late for work because of a car crash.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我因為一場車禍上班遲到了。

vocab.sentence_en: He got injured while playing soccer yesterday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 他昨天踢足球時受傷了。

items.title_en: New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade postponed due to weather
items.title_zh: 紐約梅西感恩節遊行因天氣因素延期
items.summary_en: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade in New York is moved to Saturday. Strong winds make it unsafe for the big balloons. Officials want to keep everyone safe.
items.summary_zh: 紐約的梅西感恩節遊行改期至週六舉行。強風讓大型氣球的飛行變得不安全。官員希望確保所有人的安全。
items.why_important_en: The parade is a famous event. Changing the date affects many people's holiday plans.
items.why_important_zh: 這場遊行是著名的活動。更改日期會影響許多人的假期計畫。

vocab.definition_en: To arrange for an event to take place at a later time.
vocab.sentence_en: We had to postpone our meeting until next week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們必須將會議延期到下週。

vocab.sentence_en: The flight was canceled due to bad weather.
vocab.sentence_zh: 航班因為惡劣天氣而取消了。

items.title_en: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
items.title_zh: 測試地球防禦系統的小行星影像顯示出體育場大小的隕石坑
items.summary_en: A spacecraft crashed into an asteroid four years ago. New pictures show a very large hole on the surface. This test helps scientists protect Earth.
items.summary_zh: 四年前，一艘太空船撞向了一顆小行星。新的照片顯示表面有一個非常大的坑。這項測試有助於科學家保護地球。
items.why_important_en: This shows how humans can protect the planet from space objects. It is a big step for science.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了人類如何保護地球免受太空物體撞擊。這是科學上的一大進步。

vocab.sentence_en: Please wipe the surface of the table clean.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請把桌子的表面擦乾淨。

vocab.sentence_en: I need to test the new software before the meeting.
vocab.sentence_zh: 會議前我需要測試一下新軟體。

items.title_en: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
items.title_zh: 美國陸軍稱愛荷華州的受控爆炸測試「非常成功」
items.summary_en: The US Army did a controlled explosion in Iowa. People were worried, but the results were good. Officials say the air is safe.
items.summary_zh: 美國陸軍在愛荷華州進行了一次受控爆炸。民眾原本很擔心，但結果很好。官員表示空氣是安全的。
items.why_important_en: It shows that military tests can be done safely near people. It helps calm public fears.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示軍事測試可以在靠近民眾的地方安全進行。這有助於平息大眾的恐懼。

vocab.sentence_en: The new marketing project was a big success.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新的行銷專案非常成功。

vocab.definition_en: A feeling of worry about something.
vocab.sentence_en: The manager expressed concern about the low sales.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理表達了對低銷售額的擔憂。

items.title_en: All hostages rescued after Colombian security forces storm supermarket, police say
items.title_zh: 哥倫比亞警方表示，安全部隊突襲超市後所有人質獲救
items.summary_en: Police in Colombia saved all the hostages in a supermarket. The event lasted all day. One person who took the hostages died.
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞警方救出了超市內的所有人質。這起事件持續了一整天。其中一名劫持人質的人死亡。
items.why_important_en: This was a dangerous situation in a public place. The rescue saved many lives.
items.why_important_zh: 這是在公共場所發生的危險情況。這次救援挽救了許多生命。

vocab.definition_en: To save someone from a dangerous situation.
vocab.sentence_en: The firefighters were able to rescue the cat.
vocab.sentence_zh: 消防員成功救出了那隻貓。

vocab.definition_en: A group of people trained for a specific job, like the police or army.
vocab.sentence_en: She decided to join the police force last year.
